errors.DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Booking rejected: more than 10 hours of work per day are not allowed (ArbZG §3).
errors.BUDGET_EXCEEDED: Booking rejected: the free budget of this order is not enough.
errors.INVALID_DURATION: Booking rejected: the duration must be a positive number of whole minutes.
errors.ORDER_NOT_FOUND: Booking rejected: this order does not exist.
errors.ORDER_NOT_ASSIGNED: Booking rejected: you can only book on orders of your own company.
errors.DATE_IN_FUTURE: Booking rejected: the date is in the future. Book time once the work is done.
errors.NOT_YOUR_ORDER: Only the project manager of this order can see its budget.
errors.INVALID_JSON: The request could not be read.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
errors.CONSULTANT_NEEDS_SUPPLIER: A consultant must belong to a supplier. Choose the consultant's company.
errors.SUPPLIER_ONLY_FOR_CONSULTANTS: Only consultants belong to a supplier. Project managers and admins work for the client; leave the supplier empty.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email address already exists.
errors.SUNDAY_OR_HOLIDAY: Booking rejected: no work on Sundays and public holidays (German Working Time Act §9).
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Please enter a valid email address and a password.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: The server cannot be reached. Is the API running?
